synopsis: AVL claims correlation of up to 97% for its VSM vehicle models; both the tools chapter and glossary repeat this vendor claim [f8801, f16098]. In April 2023, AVL coupled CARLA with VSM vehicle dynamics and a soft-soil tire model to test an autonomous tractor, but the corpus cites this only as an integration precedent [f8475]. The tools chapter explicitly supports CARLA with AVL VSM and a soft-soil tire model through Model.CONNECT [f8702]. The supplied facts do not establish that the claimed correlation applies to that tractor integration or to the target collision-mitigation system [f8801, f8475, f8702].

relations.note: The glossary repeats the tools chapter’s vendor correlation claim.
The tractor integration provides precedent for the supported combination, without establishing target-system validation.
